class.name: World3D
class.brief_description: A resource that holds all components of a 3D world, such as a visual scenario and a physics space.
class.description: Class that has everything pertaining to a world: A physics space, a visual scenario, and a sound space. 3D nodes register their resources into the current 3D world.

members.member: The default [CameraAttributes] resource to use if none set on the [Camera3D].

Direct access to the world's physics 3D space state. Used for querying current and potential collisions. When using multi-threaded physics, access is limited to [method Node._physics_process] in the main thread.
The World3D's fallback environment will be used if [member environment] fails or is missing.
The [RID] of this world's navigation map. Used by the [NavigationServer3D].

Global world-space wind direction vector forwarded to the scenario via [method RenderingServer.scenario_set_wind]. Used by procedural foliage wind when [member ProjectSettings.rendering/nextgeo/experimental/foliage_wind] is enabled.
Global wind gust oscillation frequency multiplier in Hertz forwarded to the scenario via [method RenderingServer.scenario_set_wind].
Global wind strength multiplier forwarded to the scenario via [method RenderingServer.scenario_set_wind]. A value of [code]0.0[/code] disables wind displacement.
